news.text: 🇪🇸👀 "A new development for the left-back position is #Miranda: info taken, scouted and groundwork tested. His contract expires in 2028, #Bologna wants to lock him down, but he and his entourage are taking their time. There are excellent relations between the clubs, and the bianconeri, given that they need a player in that role, could try to sign him in January for a transfer fee. He is also liked by #Milan and #Newcastle."[Nicolò Schira - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

👋⁉️ "Among the absolute priorities, beyond the striker issue, is that of the left-back. Today, #Juventus is not convinced by #Cambiaso, while #Cabal, despite having played in recent matches, is not someone who changes your life and does not have the kind of performance level that would stop the club from going to the mercato. Translation: if a good offer arrives, he remains in the transfer list."[Nicolò Schira - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🇽🇰⚠️ "It is normal for #Zhegrova to be starting to look around. If previously it was #Juventus hoping for the arrival of an offer, now it is his own entourage seriously exploring new horizons and wondering whether it is time for a change. It is definitely a situation to monitor in January. Other clubs have seen that he is doing well and could become interested."[Romeo Agresti - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

👀 Francisco #Conceição has returned to training at #Spalletti's disposal, meaning #Juventus recovers him for the return from the international break.He was never truly close to leaving #Juve during the summer, first and foremost by his own will.He feels good at #Juventus, wants to stay and is very happy that #Juve bet heavily on him a year and a half ago when they paid a significant fee to sign him.THE PREMIER LEAGUE AND #ALHILAL▪️ There was a lot of talk about the Premier League, but those stories were neither concrete nor true▫️ #AlHilal had evaluated him on a shortlist of two or three wingers, but ultimately went with #Martinelli and #Summerville."[@FabrizioRomano and @MatteMoretto on You

👀 #Juventus has set its sights on Juan #Miranda, #Bologna's Spanish left-back, to give Luciano #Spalletti a left-footed full-back ideal for his style of play.He has already tallied 6 assists at this start of the season: no one in Serie A has been as decisive with their passes.THE COMPETITION▪️ Initial inquiries have arrived from #Newcastle in the Premier League.▫️ In Italy, #Milan also appreciates him, having had the chance to sign him on a free transfer two years ago before deciding to let him pass.THE CONTRACT▪️ His deal with #Bologna expires in 19 months, in 2028▫️ For the past few weeks, the rossoblù club has been trying to open talks for a renewal, but so far there has been no agreement

🧐⚡️"Reflections are underway regarding #Cambiaso and #Cabal: if an offer arrived for both, there wouldn't be a mindset of 'I absolutely have to keep one'. The issue is figuring out who might make a concrete proposal: for the Colombian, it could be easier, whereas for the Italian, they will try to set up a player swap. If #Juventus had to choose to keep one, the preference would fall on the ex #Verona."[Romeo Agresti - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🔛🎯 "#Juventus is making evaluations for the midfield. We aren't even able to establish when #Thuram will be available again: nobody can guarantee it. As for #Locatelli, on the other hand, we are talking about February/March. Among the names, #Hojbjerg's comes back up: he is a player that #Spalletti and the management appreciate very much."[Romeo Agresti - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🆙❗️"#Juventus's strategies are becoming very clear: they are working on a striker, a midfielder and a left-back. However, what continues to be reiterated to me is that they also need to free up space. The mercato will be tied to sustainability and opportunities. There will be several outgoing situations to monitor. Among agents and intermediaries, movement is starting to pick up."[Romeo Agresti - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🤵🏻‍♂🧐 "#Juventus, the coaching situation:👔/👨‍🦲 #Conte wants a project where he can build, with the bianconeri there has never been a real and official contact to date. There is trust in #Spalletti, who has never been set risk, though there is a need to stabilize results. From this perspective, he should always be kept an eye on, though without immediate developments;🇮🇹 #Inzaghi has not yet decided to leave #AlHilal, but it cannot be ruled out. In the event of an exit, he would welcome a return to Italy. La Vecchia Signora should not be underestimated if they find themselves in a situation of change.
